As for the letter from Judge Davis, I shall attend to it immediately and draft a response without further delay. It is crucial to maintain order and organization in our work, and I take full responsibility for falling short in this regard.

Please accept my apologies, Mr. Herndon. I will make it a priority to rectify these oversights and ensure that such lapses do not occur again in the future. Thank you for bringing these matters to my attention.
